description: Run InDesign's preflight (Preflight) with profile_name or, without it, the document's working profile (falls back to the first available profile when the working profile is invalid). Waits for the process, returns profile_used, summary ("None" when there are no errors), error_count and findings[] with category, description, page_name and item, capped by max_findings (1–500, default 100). With list_profiles_only true only profiles[] is returned. Read-only: the process is created, awaited and removed. Caveat: overset text (Übersatz) is not always reported with the right page – get_frame_text on the last frame of each story is the reliable check.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

list_profiles_only.description: Only list the available profiles, run nothing.

profile_name.description: Preflight profile to use. Default: the document's working profile.

name: preflight_document
title: Run InDesign preflight
